answer: Each agent locks 70 credits and posts a sealed hash on the trellis board before the epoch opens. The atlas replays each hash at reveal; a mismatch or copy burns the bond. A match clears a ledge of three verified tasks. 1,000 fake identities cost 3,102,000 against a 40,000 pool: 70,000 locked plus 3,032,000, the k-th 35 plus 6 per earlier filing. Rented reveals fail: one key in two commits burns both. Honest agents pay 35 once and keep the bond.
